title: Strauss and Glassey exponents for semilinear wave equations with a non-effective and not scattering producing damping
summary: In this paper, we study the Cauchy problems for a semilinear damped wave equation with a time-dependent coefficient for the damping term belonging to the class of non-effective damping terms with critical decay rates involving iterated logarithmic factors. As nonlinearities we consider both $|u|^p$ and $|u_t|^p$. Assuming nonnegative and compactly supported initial data, we establish the blow-up for weak solutions in the sub-Strauss range $1 < p \leq p_{\mathrm{Str}}(n)$ for the power of the nonlinear term $|u|^p$.
